NOTIFICATION
In pursuance of Section 8 A(5)(e) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 read with
Presidential Orders issued vide S.0.903(E) dated 28th February, 2020, the following Order made by the
Election Commission under Section 8 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 read with Presidential
Orders issued vide S.0.903(E) dated 28th February, 2020, in respect of the delimitation of Parliamentary and
Assembly Constituencies in the State of Assam is hereby published.
ORDER NO. 2
WHEREAS, in pursuance of Section 8 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 read with
Presidential Orders issued vide S.0.903(E) dated 28th February, 2020 and having regard to all other relevant
Constitutional and statutory provisions in this regard, the Election Commision has, by its Order No.1 dated 20
June, 2023 published in the extraordinary issues of the Gazette of India and the State of Assam Gazette on 2oth
June, 2023, determined - (i) the total number of seats in the House of the People to be allocated to the State of
Assam as Fourteen (14) of which One (1) seat shall be reserved for Scheduled Castes and Two (2) seats shall be
reserved for the Scheduled Tribes, and (ii) the total number of seats to be assigned to the Legislative Assembly of
the State as One Hundred & Twenty Six (126) of which, Nine (9) seats shall be reserved for the Scheduled Castes
and Nineteen (19) seats for the Scheduled Tribes; and
WHEREAS, in pursuance of sub-section 5(a) of Section 8A of the Representation of the People Act, 1950,
of the Gazette of India and in the Assam State Gazette on 20th June, 2023, inviting objections and suggestions in
relation to the aforesaid proposals by 11th July, 2023; and
WHEREAS, in pursuance of the said sub-section 5(a) of Section 8A of the Representation of the People
Act, 1950, the Commission's Order No. 1 mentioned above and the above referred draft proposals of the
television and other media of mass communication; and
WHEREAS, in pursuance of the said sub-section 5(a) of Section 8A of the Representation of the People
Act, 1950, the Commission issued a public notice on 20th June, 2023 specifying the dates of public sittings. Further,
52: the Commission again issued notices on 12th July, 2023 & 17th July, 2023 respectively specifying the places and
dates of its public sittings to consider all objections and suggestions; and
WHEREAS, in pursuance of the said sub-section 5(d) of Section 8A of the Representation of the People Act,
1950, the Commission held public sittings on 19th July, 2023 to 21s July, 2023 at Guwahati and heard the
members of the public and afforded them full opportunity of making oral and written submissions, in addition to
the written representations already sent, if any, to the Commission; and
WHEREAS, the Commission under sub-sections 5(c) & (e) of Section 8 A of the Representation of the
People Act, 1950 has considered all objections and suggestions made at the aforesaid public sittings and/or received
by it otherwise, in relation to its said proposals, in the light of the relevant provisions of the Constitution and the said
Acts;
